name: Public address system
description: Public address system for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / I&C. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — audio channels routed by network controller
specifications.basis: Bosch Public Address Products databook, Praesideo section (publisher Bosch Security Systems B.V., file hosted by pagcanada.com; r.jina.ai reports Published Time Thu, 16 Mar 2017), read via r.jina.ai: 'Control and routing of 28 audio channels'.

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — priority levels
specifications.basis: Bosch Praesideo databook, PRS-NCO-B network controller, read via r.jina.ai: 'The system can handle 256 priorities, for calls to hundreds of zones'.

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — fault log capacity
specifications.basis: Bosch Praesideo databook, read via r.jina.ai: 'A built-in memory stores the last 200 fault messages' and 'stores the last 200 fault messages in the system'.

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — power amplifier rating
specifications.unit: W overall rating per amplifier type (1x500 W, 2x250 W, 4x125 W, 8x60 W variants)
specifications.basis: Bosch Praesideo databook, read via r.jina.ai: 'The overall power rating is 500 watts for all of the amplifiers' and model list LBB 4421/10 1x500 W, LBB 4422/10 2x250 W, LBB 4424/10 4x125 W, LBB 4428/00 8x60 W.

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — loudspeaker output voltages
specifications.basis: Bosch Praesideo databook, read via r.jina.ai: 'The power amplifiers can be selected for 100 V, 70 V and 50 V output tapping'. (value: 100 V / 70 V / 50 V)

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — emergency standard certification
specifications.basis: Bosch Praesideo databook certifications table, read via r.jina.ai: 'EVAC (TÜV certified) acc. to IEC 60849 / BS 5839-8'; 'Praesideo is the first system to be certified according to the IEC 60849 standard'. (value: IEC 60849 / BS 5839-8 (TÜV certified), controller and amplifiers)

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — backup supply
specifications.basis: Bosch Praesideo databook PRS-NCO-B, read via r.jina.ai: 'The controller operates both on mains power and on a 48 V battery power supply for emergency back up, with automatic switchover.'

specifications.metric: Bosch Praesideo digital public address — network controller node capacity
specifications.basis: Bosch Praesideo databook PRS-NCO-B, read via r.jina.ai: 'The network controller can control up to 60 nodes.'

gaps.why: No project-specific PA zone count, amplifier/loudspeaker quantities, fire-interface details or price was found; no Bosch (or alternative) PA award for this plant was read.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the PA system specification, speaker layout drawing and priced BOQ from the EPC package.
